en:
Shuichi, have you given more thought
to our previous discussion?
<CLT=cltMIND>Our previous discussion?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I remember.
When I suggested he fake the singing...

Yes, I have, Keebo.
I apologize for saying what I did.

I accept your apology. After all, humans and
robots alike seek greater understanding.

As for my robot business...if I can't be a pop
star, I'll have to think of something else.

But I can't seem to think of anything...
Do you have any ideas?

<CLT=cltMIND>Something else Keebo
could get into...
Stuntwork
High-risk work
Robo-maid
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>I really upset him last time,
I should think hard about this...
What about stuntwork? Like a stuntman?
Stuntwork?

Yeah, because you're a robot, you can
stand in for a lot of things.

That may be, but...I'm not exactly the most
physically sturdy robot, so...
Ah, that's right...

What about high-risk work?
Like in hazardous areas?
Are you implying...

that I can't die because I'm a robot!? That's
the most robophobic thing I've ever heard!

N-No, that's not what I was
trying to say!
What about...a robo-maid?

...I think you've been partaking in too
much science fiction.

Besides...I couldn't possibly be a better
maid than Kirumi...
Ah, that's true...
Alright then, ah...

Perhaps a caregiver robot? With life expectancy
rising, I am sure there is demand.

Hmm, a caregiver robot...
I hadn't considered that.

Alright, I will begin practicing at once.
I'm counting on you to help me, Shuichi.

What? How could I possibly
help you, Keebo?

I would like you to roleplay as someone
in my care.

Ah, I see.
Alright, sure.

First, I will attempt to assist you in getting
ready for bed.

Ready for bed, alright...
Can you help me change into pajamas?

Ch-Ch-Changing clothes!? I can't do that!
It's too embarrassing!

It's care work, Keebo.
You don't have to be embarrassed...

What's embarrassing is embarrassing and
that's that! No clothes-changing!
Alright, alright...

I-I suppose I'll try picking you up and placing
you on the bed.

There's no bed here, so I suppose
we'll just have to make do...

<CLT=cltMIND>I got in the fetal position so that
Keebo could carry me more easily.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is kind of embarrassing...
This could easily lead to a misunderstanding...
Okay, here I...go!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo announced with determination,
then began to lift me up...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>CRACK!
Ergh!?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Hm?
He's not picking me up...
Keebo? What's wrong?

O-Oooouuuch...!
M-My back, my back...!

Your back!?
I thought you were a robot!
Y-You're too heavy...!
I-I am not! I'm normal for my age!

Ah! Ooouuuuch...!
It hurts to move my back...!

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess that makes caregiving
out of the question...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>K1-B0's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ironically, I ended up carrying Keebo on
my back and taking him to his room.
